title: Investor Protection, MiFID and the Volcker Rule

maps.tested: Rated Very Important; the handwritten sheet names MiFID and the Volcker Rule explicitly.
maps.specifics: Suitability and appropriateness obligations, best execution, conflicts-of-interest management, and the proprietary-trading prohibition with its market-making and hedging exemptions. Scope/condition errors on the exemptions are the natural distractor.

vardeezReading: ORR-14: Very Important. ORR-12: Very Important. ORR-5: untiered, with the note to use the crash course notes for ORR-1 to ORR-9 and no Schweser. ORR-3: untiered, with the same note to use the crash course notes for ORR-1 to ORR-9 and no Schweser.

selectors.name: Suitability and appropriateness obligations
selectors.what: When each obligation applies and what it checks: suitability for investment advice and portfolio management (knowledge and experience, financial situation including ability to bear losses, investment objectives including risk tolerance); appropriateness for non-advised services in complex products (knowledge and experience only); execution-only dealing in non-complex products at the client's initiative needs neither. Also suitability as Basel category 4.1 and the incentive that steers customers to higher-margin products without regard to suitability.

selectors.name: Best execution, Deutsche Bank Securities case
selectors.what: Best execution as seeking the most favourable terms reasonably available for the customer (FINRA Rule 5310: price improvement, speed of execution; MiFID II: all sufficient steps considering price, costs, speed, likelihood of execution and settlement, size and nature of the order), and the Deutsche Bank Securities FINRA fine of USD 2 million for routing market orders through the SuperX ping, untested price improvement and vague rebate disclosure.

selectors.name: Conflicts of interest under MiFID II, MiFIR
selectors.what: What MiFID II and MiFIR address (remuneration of traders and advisors and conflicts of interest, fair and non-misleading communication, independence of advice, sales process and product governance, best execution, eligible counterparties), the directive versus regulation distinction (a directive is transposed nationally and a country may be more stringent but not less; a regulation applies directly), and conflict drivers such as traders dealing for both client and firm books and information asymmetry with retail investors.

selectors.name: Volcker Rule prohibition and exemptions
selectors.what: The Volcker Rule in Dodd-Frank bars banks from speculative proprietary trading for profit and limits investments in hedge funds and private equity funds, while permitting underwriting, market making within reasonably expected near-term customer demand, risk-mitigating hedging of specific identifiable risks, government obligations and trading for customers; the question tests scope and condition errors on the exemptions (for example dropping the inventory condition, or a hedge not tied to identifiable risks).

notSelected: ORR-14 b beyond best execution and the Deutsche Bank Securities case (the fine statistics, UBS auction rate securities, JP Morgan spoofing, the fraud versus error distinction and its controls), the other Dodd-Frank elements (OTC derivatives, CFPB, oversight council), and ORR-12 a, ORR-5 d and ORR-3 d, which carry no shape, no Map point and no Vardeez pointer for this topic.
